author: NolanDalton
body: While most staff know obvious hacks like Kill Aura/Anti-KB, There are obviously more uncommon ones that staff don't know, imo there needs to be some tests for junior mods/staff candidates during their trial process. It is more than necessary that new staff know all types of hacks.

replies.body: We're currently working on a training system. All of the currents mods will be trained. In addition, before a promotion, users will be trained too.
